snippet.title: BrokenLore: Don't Watch - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014853/

BrokenLore: DON’T WATCH – A first-person psychological horror.
Shinji, a hikikomori, is trapped in his tiny 6m² Tokyo apartment.
Cut off from the world. No escape.
The days blur… and something is lurking in the dark.
